pass.answer: After you quit Kindle, re-enable the firewall block.
Your firewall rule is off (`False`); put it back on with `firewall.ps1 -Action enable`.
Run `Enable-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName 'Block Kindle for PC (lock 2.8.0)'` from an elevated prompt.

fail.answer: Delete the installer and keep syncing with the firewall off.
Disable the firewall block again if the book still fails.
